name: humanoid
description: Generic clothed adult humanoid (NPC, survivor, soldier). Unity Humanoid minimum plus fingers recommended; hitboxes on, gore off. Numbers are PROPOSALS.

motion_prompts.Idle: A person stands relaxed in place, shifting weight gently from foot to foot with arms at the sides.
motion_prompts.Walk: A person walks forward at a steady relaxed pace in a straight line, arms swinging naturally.
motion_prompts.Run: A person jogs forward in a straight line at a steady pace with relaxed arms.
motion_prompts.Death: A person standing upright collapses to the ground and lies still.

reference_guidance: Original fictional adult only: no real-person likeness, celebrity, brand or franchise noun.
Full-body neutral A-pose with hands away from the thighs, plain background, even lighting.
Consistent clothing across views; separate matching portrait for the face.
